answer: The admission burn is multiplied by 13 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. The ledge multiplier is published, charged in pearl, and pigment lists each payment. A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, as the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. A farm of 1949 identities would post 4291 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
